Where a UAV System is designed for conventional take-off and landing on a runway, it must include the following function :
(a) The automatic system must incorporate a manual abort function. Its control shall be easily accessible to the UAV crew in order to
  (1) stop the UAV on the runway during the take-off run at every speed up to refusal speed or rotation speed VR, whichever is less.
  (2) where it is safe to perform, initiate a go around during the landing phase at every height down to a Decision Point.
(b) Specific go around procedure shall be provided in the UAV System Flight Manual under USAR.1585 (j).

Where a UAS is designed for conventional take-off and landing on a runway and is equipped with automatic systems for taxi , take-off, landing or any combination thereof, it must include the following functions:
(a) The automatic system must incorporate a manual abort function. Its control shall be easily accessible to the UAS crew in order to:
  (1) stop the UA on the runway during the take-off run at every speed up to refusal speed or rotation speed VR, whichever is less.
  (2) where it is safe to perform, initiate a go around during the landing phase at every height down to a Decision Point.
(b) Specific go around procedure shall be provided in the UAS Flight Manual under USAR.1585 (j).
